// Separate region blocker exposed by testing projection proofs.
// Rustc accepts; Flux MIR rejects returning next() as borrowing local `it`.
fn first<'a, I: IntoIterator<Item = &'a u32>>(input: I) -> Option<&'a u32>
where
    I::IntoIter: ExactSizeIterator,
{
    let mut it = input.into_iter();
    if it.len() == 0 {
        assert_eq!(it.count(), 0);
        return None;
    }
    it.next()
}
fn main() {}
